verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for POS software, since self-hostable POS systems exist, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Shopify POS only as iOS/Android apps that sync with Shopify's hosted back office, with no self-hosted deployment option. POS UI extensions and Admin API access are developer building blocks, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
